Musical Fidelity Launches B1xcd Compact Disc Player with Home Hi-Fi Focus

Physical media enthusiasts have a new home audio option with the announcement of the Musical Fidelity B1xcd compact disc player. Positioned as a comparatively affordable entry in the high-end audio space, the unit is designed for stationary home hi-fi setups rather than portable listening.

Pricing and Availability

  • Confirmed Model: Musical Fidelity B1xcd
  • Launch Window: Announced ahead of a release starting from October 2026.
  • Local Price (Europe): MSRP of €599.
  • Approximate Conversions: Roughly $670, £500, or AU$1,000 based on currency rates.

Hardware and Audio Specifications

  • Build: Large-body device featuring a metal chassis, aluminum control icons, and weighing 5.8kg.
  • Display: Integrated LCD screen for track information.
  • Audio Processing: Built-in ESS DAC designed specifically for audio CDs, supporting the standard Red Book CD format created in 1980.

Connectivity and Outputs

To integrate with existing home audio equipment, the B1xcd includes multiple output options:

  • Analogue outputs (RCA)
  • Digital outputs (coaxial and optical)

Software Support and Verification

Official software support details have not been extensively detailed in the initial announcement. Interested buyers can verify specifications, regional availability updates, and official product details by visiting the official Musical Fidelity website or checking authorized high-fi audio dealers as the October 2026 release window approaches.
